question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN user_age >= 20 AND user_age < 30 THEN '20s'
    WHEN user_age >= 30 AND user_age < 40 THEN '30s'
    WHEN user_age >= 40 AND user_age < 50 THEN '40s'
    WHEN user_age >= 50 AND user_age < 60 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS user_age
  FROM mst_users
)
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category
